metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2011 · Thor
metas.description: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard (Earth), where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2013 · Thor: The Dark World
metas.description: When the Dark Elves attempt to plunge the universe into darkness, Thor must embark on a perilous and personal journey that will reunite him with doctor Jane Foster.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2016 · Suicide Squad
metas.description: A secret government agency recruits some of the most dangerous incarcerated super-villains to form a defensive task force. Their first mission: save the world from the apocalypse.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2017 · Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi
metas.description: Rey develops her abilities with the help of Luke Skywalker as the Resistance prepares for battle against the First Order.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2011 · Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
metas.description: Jack Sparrow and Barbossa embark on a quest to find the elusive fountain of youth, only to discover that Blackbeard and his daughter are after it too.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2018 · Aquaman
metas.description: Arthur Curry, the human-born heir to the underwater kingdom of Atlantis, goes on a quest to prevent a war between the worlds of ocean and land.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2019 · Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker
metas.description: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2017 · Justice League
metas.description: Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after eons to capture Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit and assemble Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight the powerful new enemy.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2010 · Alice in Wonderland
metas.description: Nineteen-year-old Alice returns to the magical world from her childhood adventure, where she reunites with her old friends and learns of her true destiny: to end the Red Queen's reign of terror.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2013 · This Is the End
metas.description: Six Los Angeles celebrities are stuck in James Franco's house after a series of devastating events just destroyed the city. Inside, the group not only have to face the apocalypse, but themselves.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2017 · Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
metas.description: Captain Jack Sparrow searches for the Trident of Poseidon to rule the sea while being pursued by old rival Captain Salazar and a crew of deadly ghosts who have escaped from the Devil's Triangle.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2017 · Kong: Skull Island
metas.description: After the Vietnam war, a team of scientists explores an uncharted island in the Pacific, venturing into the domain of the mighty Kong and must fight to escape a primal Eden.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2019 · It: Chapter Two
metas.description: Twenty-seven years after their first encounter with the terrifying Pennywise, the Losers Club have grown up and moved away, until a devastating phone call brings them back.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2016 · The Witch
metas.description: An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2018 · Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
metas.description: Gellert Grindelwald plans to raise an army of wizards to rule over non-magical beings. In response, Newt Scamander's former professor, Albus Dumbledore, seeks his help to stop him.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2014 · 300: Rise of an Empire
metas.description: Greek general Themistocles of Athens leads the naval charge against invading Persian forces led by mortal-turned-god Xerxes and Artemisia, vengeful commander of the Persian navy.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2010 · Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
metas.description: A young fugitive prince and princess must stop a villain who unknowingly threatens to destroy the world with a special dagger that enables the magic sand inside to reverse time.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2019 · Glass
metas.description: Security guard David Dunn uses his supernatural abilities to track Kevin Wendell Crumb, a disturbed man who has twenty-four personalities.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2010 · Clash of the Titans
metas.description: Perseus, a demigod and the son of Zeus, battles the minions of Hades and the Underworld in order to stop them from conquering Olympus and Earth.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2016 · Warcraft
metas.description: As an Orc horde invades the planet Azeroth using a magic portal, a few human heroes and dissenting Orcs must attempt to stop the true evil behind this war.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2012 · Dark Shadows
metas.description: An imprisoned vampire, Barnabas Collins, is set free and returns to his ancestral home, where his dysfunctional descendants are in need of his protection.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2012 · The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 2
metas.description: After the birth of Bella and Edward's daughter, Renesmee, the Cullens gather werewolves, vampire clans, and other allies from around the world to protect her after a false allegation puts her life in danger.

metas.name: ★ 5.0 · 2011 · The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1
metas.description: A wedding and honeymoon bring unexpected and shocking consequences for Bella and Edward, including new complications with Jacob.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2011 · Sucker Punch
metas.description: A young girl institutionalized by her abusive stepfather retreats to an alternative reality as a coping strategy and envisions a plan to help her escape.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2016 · Ghostbusters
metas.description: Following a ghost invasion of Manhattan, paranormal enthusiasts Erin Gilbert and Abby Yates, nuclear engineer Jillian Holtzmann, and subway worker Patty Tolan band together to stop the otherworldly threat.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2018 · Tomb Raider
metas.description: Lara Croft, the fiercely independent daughter of a missing adventurer, must push herself beyond her limits when she discovers the island where her father, Lord Richard Croft disappeared.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2019 · Godzilla: King of the Monsters
metas.description: The crypto-zoological agency Monarch faces off against a battery of god-sized monsters, including the mighty Godzilla, who collides with Mothra, Rodan, and his ultimate nemesis, the three-headed King Ghidorah.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2013 · Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
metas.description: Brother/sister duo Hansel and Gretel are professional witch-hunters who help innocent villagers. One day they stumble upon a case that could hold the key to their past.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2017 · The Mummy
metas.description: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia and terrors that defy human comprehension.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2014 · Dracula Untold
metas.description: As his kingdom is being threatened by the Turks, young prince Vlad Tepes must become a monster feared by his own people in order to obtain the power needed to protect his own family, and the families of his kingdom.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2013 · Oz the Great and Powerful
metas.description: A small-time magician is swept away to an enchanted land and is forced into a power struggle among three witches.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2010 · Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
metas.description: A teenager discovers he's the descendant of a Greek god and sets out on an adventure to settle an on-going battle between the gods.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2017 · Bright
metas.description: A detective must work with an Orc to find a powerful wand before evil creatures do.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2011 · The Change-Up
metas.description: One fateful morning, family man Dave and bachelor Mitch wake up in each other's bodies as a result of a wish they made the previous evening.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2012 · Wrath of the Titans
metas.description: Perseus braves the treacherous underworld to rescue his father, Zeus, captured by his son, Ares, and brother Hades who unleash the ancient Titans upon the world.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2013 · Mama
metas.description: Two little girls disappear into the woods the day that their parents were killed. When they are found 5 years later and begin a new life, they find that someone or something still wants to tuck them in at night.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2012 · The Woman in Black
metas.description: A young solicitor travels to a remote village where he discovers that the vengeful ghost of a scorned woman is terrorizing the locals.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2011 · The Tree of Life
metas.description: The story of a family in Waco, Texas in 1956. The eldest son witnesses the loss of innocence and struggles with his parents' conflicting teachings.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2019 · Yesterday
metas.description: A struggling musician realizes he's the only person on Earth who can remember The Beatles after waking up in an alternate reality where they never existed.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2011 · Immortals
metas.description: Theseus is a mortal man chosen by Zeus to lead the fight against the ruthless King Hyperion, who is on a rampage across Greece to obtain a weapon that can destroy humanity.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2013 · 47 Ronin
metas.description: A band of samurai sets out to avenge the death and dishonor of their master at the hands of a ruthless shogun.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2010 · The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
metas.description: Lucy and Edmund Pevensie return to Narnia with their cousin Eustace where they sail with King Caspian to help Narnian lords banished by an evil usurper of the throne.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2014 · Hercules
metas.description: Having endured his legendary twelve labors, Hercules, the Greek demigod, has his life as a sword-for-hire tested when the King of Thrace and his daughter seek his aid in defeating a tyrannical warlord.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2012 · Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
metas.description: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th President of the United States, discovers vampires are planning to take over the United States. He makes it his mission to eliminate them.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2012 · Underworld: Awakening
metas.description: When human forces discover the existence of the Vampire and Lycan clans, a war to eradicate both species commences. The vampire warrior Selene leads the battle against humankind.
